goal: A single page that converts Celsius to Fahrenheit.

phase.name: build
phase.objective: Build the page and prove it in a browser.

criteria.text: Entering 100 shows '212 F'; empty input shows an error, never NaN.

decisions.question: Where does the page run?
decisions.choice: opened from disk as file://index.html, no server

nodes.objective: Build index.html with one input and a result line, no network.
nodes.verifier: browser-reviewer: opens the page and runs every browser_check step

steps: type 100 in the input: the page shows '212 F'
clear the input: an error message shows and the page text has no NaN
at 375px width there is no horizontal scroll

nodes.objective: Run the whole tool end to end and fix seams.

gates.check: python3.11 -c "import sys;sys.exit(1 if 'http' in open('index.html').read() else 0)"
